title: SqliteStore/SqliteBlockStore: open() silently succeeds on incompatible existing schema
description: Trigger: operator points sqlite backend at an existing .db file whose blocks table has a different schema (e.g., missing column from a future migration, or wrong database file). CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op on the existing table; open() returns Ok. The mismatch is only discovered at first article ingest, producing a confusing IpfsWriteError::WriteFailed with a SQLite column count error — not a startup failure. Fix: after CREATE TABLE, verify the schema with SELECT cid, codec, data, byte_size, stored_at FROM blocks LIMIT 0 and return Err on failure.
